scope: Proposition 7.7 (Vanishing singular contribution) of the manuscript “A counterexample to Sidorenko's conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Sidorenkos-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 161 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0c0d7b5eb1ed43c0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 46-47. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
